_comment: Every commercial constant lives here. No magic numbers in code, ever. This whole block is copied verbatim into dispatch.json.assumptions so Screen 4 needs no second fetch — see docs/Schema.md section 4.
tier: Tier 2 — labelled assumption, see PRD v2 section 6

notes.tariff_rm_per_kwh: Malaysian RP4, in force 1 Jul 2025 to 31 Dec 2027. Base total 45.4 sen/kWh plus AFA 3.59 sen/kWh = 48.99 sen = RM 0.4899. Base and AFA are Tier 1 (widely reported). Source: https://www.mytnb.com.my/business/understand-your-bill/pricing-tariff
notes.tariff_rm_per_kwh_range: RP4 is a four-component structure plus AFA, not a flat rate. The component split is a secondary source, so the rate ships as a range: 40.0 to 49.0 sen base plus AFA. The dispatch conclusion must hold at the low end — see PRD v2 section 13 item 5.
notes.cost_per_visit_rm: Tier 2 assumption. No public figure exists for Malaysian C&I site-visit cost. Mid point of an 800 to 2500 range covering technician time, travel and mobilisation.
notes.cost_per_visit_rm_range: Screen 4's pessimistic toggle recomputes headline figures at the unfavourable end of every range: lowest tariff, highest visit cost.
notes.dispatch_threshold_rm_per_month: A site is worth visiting when the monthly loss exceeds the cost of going. Set at the high end of the visit-cost range so a dispatch survives the worst corner of every assumption.
notes.min_cohort_size: Below this, the cohort control group is too weak to be meaningful. PRD v2 section 15. Cohorts under this size are flagged, never hidden.
notes.sub_site_deviation_threshold: An inverter is flagged when its mean daily output sits this far below the median of its siblings on the same roof. Siblings share weather perfectly, so divergence is unambiguous. Ratio-based because PVDAQ does not publish per-inverter capacity.
notes.min_plausible_performance_index: Data-quality floor in kWh/kWp/day. A working C&I site does not average below this anywhere the fleet operates; a site that does has incomplete telemetry, not a fault. Such sites are excluded from detection AND from their cohort median, because a permanently depressed reading both generates a false dispatch and drags the peer baseline down. Exclusion is stated on screen, never silent.
notes.assumed_yield_kwh_per_kwp_day: Nominal specific yield used only for sanity checks and demo estimates, never as a substitute for the M2 physics baseline. NOT a Malaysian figure and not derived from one — see malaysia_reference_yield_kwh_per_kwp_day, which is a separate constant for a separate purpose. Do not merge them.
notes.malaysia_reference_yield_kwh_per_kwp_day: DERIVED REFERENCE ESTIMATE, not a measurement and not Tier 1. Mean modelled specific yield across four real Malaysian coordinates (Bukit Raja/Klang, Senai, Nilai, Ipoh), from PVGIS-ERA5 satellite weather averaged 2005-2020 through PVGIS's physical PV model. Depends entirely on chosen parameters: 100 kWp c-Si, roof-mounted (building-integrated), 10 degree tilt, 0 degree azimuth (south), 14 percent system loss. Change any one and the figure moves — roof-mounting alone costs about 4 percent against free-standing. Regenerate with pipeline/fetch_malaysia_reference.py; method note in docs/MALAYSIA-REFERENCE.md. NO Malaysian site measured this: no openly reusable per-site Malaysian inverter time series exists (docs/RESEARCH.md section 5). Never present it as measured output and never use it as ground truth for detection accuracy.

Spread across the four sites, lowest (Senai) to highest (Bukit Raja/Klang). This range falls entirely inside the observed spread of the real PVDAQ fleet (3.52 to 4.76 kWh/kWp/day, recomputable with pipeline/fleet_median.py), which supports using that fleet to demonstrate the method. It does NOT claim the fleets are operationally equivalent — one side is measured output from specific hardware and operations, the other is modelled reference output.
notes.baseline_visit_frequency_per_year: Calendar-driven visit cadence the product replaces. Twelve equals monthly.
notes.co2e_grid_factor_kg_per_kwh: Tier 1. Malaysia grid emission factor, Energy Commission 2024. Recovered generation times this factor gives tCO2e avoided for the ESG rubric row.
